# ethereum-optimism/optimism Monthly Report (March 2026)

## 🚀 Highlights
In March 2026, development activity focused on refining the codebase through targeted maintenance and performance optimizations. Key efforts centered on the `kona-derive` crate and the `supernode` interop components, emphasizing the removal of legacy code and the improvement of concurrency patterns. These updates, alongside a suite of dependency upgrades, reflect a continued commitment to protocol stability and the technical health of the OP Stack.

## 🛠️ Key Developments

### Kona Maintenance and Refactoring
Efforts were made to streamline the `kona-derive` crate by identifying and removing obsolete components.
*   **Dead Code Removal**: Following the identification of orphaned files, a pull request was opened to remove `EthereumDataSourceVariant` and `sources/variant.rs`, which referenced non-existent iterators and stale APIs ([#19341](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19341)).

### Supernode Performance & Interoperability
Refinements to the supernode infrastructure focused on resource management and execution reliability.
*   **Goroutine Management**: To prevent resource leaks and ensure clean execution exits, logic was implemented in `supernode/interop-activity` to ensure all goroutines are properly drained before a function terminates ([#19337](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19337)).

### Dependency & Tooling Updates
Regular maintenance of the project's dependency tree ensured the stack remains secure and up-to-date with the latest upstream improvements.
*   **OpenTelemetry Upgrades**: The `go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk` was bumped from version 1.34.0 to 1.40.0 across the general Go dependencies and specific Rust-based Reth test crates ([#19338](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19338), [#19339](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19339)).
*   **Documentation Tooling**: The `rollup` dependency within the `/rust/docs` directory was updated to version 4.59.0 ([#19336](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19336)).

## 🐛 Issues & Triage

### New & Active Issues
*   **Kona Technical Debt**: A significant issue was raised regarding the presence of dead code in `kona-derive`. Specifically, the `sources/variant.rs` file was flagged for referencing a non-existent `AsyncIterator`, signaling a need for better tracking of internal API changes and orphaned files ([#19340](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19340)).

## 💬 Community & Collaboration
The activity this month demonstrates a high level of attention to detail from maintainers regarding the "Kona" stack and interop components. The rapid transition from identifying dead code in an issue ([#19340](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19340)) to submitting a corrective pull request ([#19341](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19341)) highlights an efficient feedback loop between code auditing and implementation. Collaboration remains focused on core protocol infrastructure and ensuring the robustness of the Superchain's underlying crates.
